newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT - PEC, Discount rated buys.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - PEC, Discount rated buys.

text.p: PEC Israel and Discount Investment Corp, two subsidiaries of the IDB group, are both trading at far lower discounts to their net assets values (NAV) than normal, a report by UBS Securities says.
UBS rates both stocks as buys while their parent companies IDB Holding Corp and IDB Development, both traded in Tel Aviv, are holds.

Analyst Daniel Carasso said that at a price of $16.60 per share, PEC was trading on the New York Stock Exchange at a 45 percent pre-tax discount to NAV, while at a price of 18.5 shekels Discount was trading on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange at a 32 percent discount.
"Given that these holding companies normally trade in a range of 85-105 percent of NAV, these discrepencies are unusual," said Carasso.
He said the uncertainty regarding the two companies' asset values should be cleared up as the companies float and sell off assets. Both PEC and Discount should outperform in their respective markets.
